method: Per-epic Sonnet reviewers against six prototype maps, each review re-checked by an adversarial Sonnet verifier; plus a verified data-model delta and a verified reverse check.

themes.title: Contract-centred billing model
themes.description: Billing route, Type 1/2/3 and protected default Type 1s replaced by holders, dated Contract versions, standalone lines, one No contract (RVG), mandatory Contract per Procedure, staged review, authorisation snapshot. XL, split into model, versioning screens, picker.

themes.title: Pricing, units and modifiers
themes.description: Price, rate and discount held on the Procedure with no reason, Contract flag gating anaesthetist, no-charge invoice, modifier split above four, RVG hidden-key master, modifier records with explanations, age pre-applied, out-of-range warns, completion rules reworked. XL.

themes.title: Hospital intake matching screen
themes.description: No review-and-merge screen exists; HL7/FHIR and PDF rows auto-apply. Need staged rows, match/create/Draft List/reject, per-row change type, differences for approval, unmatched queue, day move as cancel plus new, edits until AUTHORISED. XL.

themes.title: NHI mandatory and text as received
themes.description: Remove provisional patients and NHI pending; waiting-for-NHI queue; procedure text kept per source with time; separate invoice description. M, bundled with intake.

themes.title: Prepayment and holding account
themes.description: Prepaid Contract triggers prepayment at line price, admin approval with letter, payable to holding account, second pair at authorise, refund on cancel, no automatic balance. Anaesthetist currently paid before the procedure. XL.

themes.title: Events, additional invoices and credit notes
themes.description: Post-op addendum Booking replaced by events on the Procedure, free-form additional invoices, credit then rebill, negative payables netted in a weekly payment cycle. XL.

themes.title: Edit window until AUTHORISED and anaesthetist views
themes.description: Anaesthetist edits stay open on SUBMITTED, List leaves main view at AUTHORISED, balances show invoices immediately, search and scroll-back. M.

themes.title: OQ-81 reversal: unavailability is never a conflict
themes.description: Remove availability conflict kind, make closed sessions non-assignable by the office, route sickness through return-or-assign to a Draft List. M to L, independent.

themes.title: Single-Booking move and notification pool
themes.description: Anaesthetist moves one Booking into a new List in a colleague's free Slot; pool notices gain resolve tick, count, show-resolved and an ask-the-office source. M.

themes.title: Payer, insurer, balances and warnings
themes.description: Payer name and email on the Booking, insurer and approval number on the Booking, patient balance alerts, remaining warning rules, ledger positions, split as a Booking action. L, after Contract rework.

themes.title: Profile, reporting and admin polish
themes.description: Drop GST period, add bank details, monthly GST of payments passed on, flat owed list, preferred pairing ordering, audit exclusions, cutover load, master calendar, simulated sign-in, scale and privacy demos, point-of-need help. M, mostly small.

epics.title: Schedule canvas, Slots and Lists
epics.observations: The cover and reassignment slice of EP-01 is mostly healthy: priority tiers (US-01.3.6), the office tier-ordered pickers, and the no-warning, availability-only own List move (US-01.4.5) are built and guarded by officePrivacy.test.ts. The gaps cluster on single-Booking moves. US-01.4.7 is Missing (no anaesthetist Booking move, no new-List-in-receiver's-Slot action, no optional admin notice or update email). US-01.4.2 needs only a name filter in the shared MoveListSheet picker (which would also serve the Booking move) and optionally a mobile date picker. US-01.4.6 is Contradicts because the prototype pays a prepaid Booking's payable to the List's anaesthetist at handoff; closing it needs the AA Holding account from EP-06 (US-06.5.1, US-06.5.4, US-06.3.5). The code already marks a 'Phase 41 seam' in store/slotActions.ts and store/listMoveActions.ts. A new anaesthetist Booking move should reuse domain/listMoves.receiveRefusal and pushTargets and the MoveListSheet shell, add an optional-notice choice, and bump PERSIST_VERSION only if the notification shape changes. OQ-102 (tier and pairing names) stays open; names are centralised in TIER_LABELS and PAIRING_LABELS, so a rename is a one-line edit. Demo script S2 (Office day: Find available, Draft List assignment, tier order, not-preferred separation) is unaffected; a single-Booking move would be a new optional beat. The user said to ignore uncommitted changes; none of these five items was graded against them.

epics.title: Booking intake and change handling
epics.observations: All eleven gradings upheld after re-reading the code. The central gap is an Admin hospital matching-and-creating screen (review and merge, unmatched queue, accept as new, approve or reject differences, save a Draft List or assign an anaesthetist), fed by a simulated day-before hospital list from St George's and Southern Cross. Code comments (integrationActions.ts:149,169; draftListActions.ts:74; NotificationsScreen.tsx:19) show the earlier plan already pointed at a Phase 33 matching screen and a Phase 35 update email, neither built. The existing HL7/FHIR simulator, feed config and Integrations monitor are badged Future scope and auto-apply to Bookings via applyEffect; they should be reframed or routed into the new screen. Contradictions to fix together: (1) NHI optional with provisional patients and 'NHI pending' Bookings (store/intake.ts, shared/format.ts nhiBadge, web ListDetailView.tsx:82, admin ReviewScreen.tsx:261, seeded provisional patient and Booking, ingestPdfRow blank NHI) versus NHI mandatory with no-NHI rows waiting at intake (also touches EP-11 US-11.1.4/11.1.5/11.1.1, seed, and PERSIST_VERSION, currently 25); (2) integration writes refused on SUBMITTED Lists (lifecycle.editRefusal) versus inbound changes accepted until authorised (US-02.5.4); (3) S13 move to another day is a reassign, not cancellation plus new Booking (US-02.5.2, whose swimlane is Future Work for the automatic part). Stubs (FT-02.6) depend on the matching screen and NHI rule and are open (OQ-118): sequence after intake and build only if OQ-118 is answered yes. US-02.3.3 draft update email is independent (history, Hospital.contactEmail, SurgeonRoom.contactEmail and the notification pool already exist) and links to EP-13 notifications and US-01.4.3. Demo script impact: S1 currently presents HL7/FHIR as illustration (DemoControlPanel.tsx:262) and would move to the matching-screen flow; S2 gains hospital rows landing in the matching screen and a Draft List created from a row; S4 dead-letter beat should become an unmatched or no-NHI row. Other children of EP-02 (US-02.5.x, US-02.2.x) were not in this batch.

epics.title: Booking and Procedure capture (anaesthetist)
epics.observations: Verification outcome: 10 of 11 gradings upheld; only US-03.3.8 corrected (Missing to Partial, because A1/A2 are removable chips and the seeded 72-year-old Ellison Booking opens with A1 selected). EP-03 is largely built on the July readings. Four clusters. (1) Events (FT-03.7, US-03.7.1/.2/.3): no Event entity; addPostOpAddendum is a Booking-on-a-List and its own comment says INTERIM until catch-up phases 38b/39b (ROADMAP D13). That work also removes BillingLine and the 'Stage post-op scenario' trigger; S4 beat 2 of the demo guide must be rewritten. (2) Price adjustment (FT-03.5 and US-03.5.1) is one fix: a per-Contract 'anaesthetist may change pricing' flag, fixed-price and prepaid locks, shown fixed discount, no reason, flag at office review; the validator's mandatory reason and negative-fee refusal plus office PriceOverrideSheet's mandatory reason go with it. (3) Modifiers and completion (US-03.3.1, 03.3.4, 03.3.8, 03.6.1) share domain/billing/fee.ts resolveBtm (ASA seeding), validateBookingForBilling (Contract + times-if-time-priced + modifier explanation replacing route + RVG-or-line + times), a new modifier explanation field on Procedure, an out-of-range base-units warning rule (US-13.7.1; only prepaymentUnpaid exists) and a DOB-based age rule. Closing 03.3.4/03.3.8 also needs the RVG table plus AA modifiers (US-05.1.5). (4) NHI mandatory (US-03.1.5) touches Patient type, nhiBadge, intake provisional patients and ManualBookingForm. Any of these changes persisted shape, so PERSIST_VERSION must be bumped, and canvas golden/fingerprint tests regenerated. Dependencies outside EP-03: EP-04 (Contract lines with default RVG code, US-04.2.4; anaesthetist changing Contract, US-03.4.1), EP-08 (additional invoice, credit note, traceability), EP-11 (billable party, insurer/approval), EP-13 warning routine. Open questions OQ-95, OQ-121, OQ-12, OQ-93 make the Verify-status grades (03.3.1, 03.3.4, 03.3.8, 03.6.1, 03.7.2) soft; none of them changes the direction of the work.

epics.title: Contracts
epics.observations: All of EP-04 sits on the July model: Contract.type 1|2|3, holderType/holderId/scope, protected per-hospital and per-insurer default Type 1s, an Insurer master with acceptsDirectClaims, and a required Procedure.billingRoute (hospital/billableParty/insurer) with an optional governingContractId resolved at billing. The catalogue replaces this with one Contract per Procedure that decides pricing and who is billed. Verification changed one item (US-04.2.2 Partial to Contradicts) because OQ-89 and US-05.2.6 make the Contract rate a unit rate, not rate x time, and the ordinal/Method 3 machinery is an older reading. Only US-04.2.8 stays Partial and US-04.2.11 Missing. Suggested order: (1) domain types and seed (Contract settings, contract holder record with billable party, practitioner links and delivery flag, Contract lines with system keys, one No contract (RVG), dated versions, retire Insurer master and defaults), (2) billing engine (resolveContractForProcedure, counterpartyForProcedure, feeFor driven by Contract and line), (3) filtered Contract picker and admin Contracts master with stage-and-submit versions. Tightly coupled outside this batch: US-03.4.1 (anaesthetist changes Contract), US-04.1.2/04.1.3/04.1.4/04.1.6, EP-05 (price override, discount, GST), FT-06.2 (prepaid via the Contract flag), EP-08 (invoice description, layout, additional invoices), EP-11 (Booking payer, insurer and approval number; OQ-93, OQ-122). Persisted state needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 13). Demo guide impact: S4 beat 2 (dating out COS ACC with no default fallback), S5 beat 4 (Health NZ effective-dating, docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md:643-652), prepayment beats, Doyle bariatric ordinal pricing, Aria hourly scenario and any beat showing hospital default Type 1 or Type labels. contract-picker-mock/ is a separate throwaway and was not graded.

epics.title: RVG master data and fee calculation rules
epics.observations: Verified against code. Main structural findings. (1) Master data: the RVG and modifier masters are demo, view-only and keyed by code; the catalogue wants NZSA-published data, a hidden system key (codes repeat), base-unit range, modifier units, AA-added groups, a 30-code modifier table plus AA's own with non-single values, and an audit of changes. One slice (editable, audited RVG and modifier masters with a re-key of rvgBaseCode across ~33 files) closes FT-05.1, US-05.1.1, 05.1.3 and most of 05.1.5; it is the biggest EP-05 piece. (2) Modifier model contradicts the catalogue: ASA class seeds an AS modifier (AsaCard, resolveBtm), age modifiers are not applied from patient age (bands still OQ-95), absorbed modifiers are inert and struck through rather than selected at 0 and removable, and one-code-per-band exclusivity is the prototype's own rule. (3) Multi-procedure: additional Procedures take time units only; the catalogue splits modifier units equally above 4 across all Procedures and ranks prepaid primaries. (4) Price adjustment: the anaesthetist override is offered everywhere, reason mandatory (also on the office sheet, contrary to 'no reason needed'), no per-Contract allow flag, allowed on fixed prices, no percentage or rate option for the anaesthetist, $0 or 100% discount raises no invoice (zero invoice group skipped), no review flag for price adjustments. (5) Fixed price is still the Type 3 price-list with a BTM fallback, and the validator still demands times and range base units for a fixed-price Procedure with an RVG code; EP-04's Contract-line model and No contract (RVG) will force US-05.2.1, 05.2.5 and 05.4.x to be re-graded and reworked together. Matches: FT-05.5, US-05.5.1 and US-05.2.1 (the engine has no ACC path; unit value per anaesthetist). Verifier correction: US-05.2.2 moved from Matches to Partial (S) for stale 'assumption' wording in the UI, code and demo guide, plus tiers not defined as data; time-unit arithmetic itself is right. Verifier also dropped two non-gaps (range not shown in the picker row, ASA seeding under US-05.1.4) and added the validator-on-fixed-price gap and the case-sensitive picker search defect. Dependencies: EP-04 (Contract model, flags, prepaid), FT-03.7 (events for ACC pre-op), US-03.3.4/03.3.8 (ASA, age modifiers), US-08.6.x (ad hoc invoice or credit), US-13.5.2 (audit). Demo-guide beats affected: S1 capture beat (rounding discovery point, ASA seeding wording), any beat showing positioning struck through or an override with a reason, and cheat sheet section 10 on modifier values and rounding. No demo trigger is needed for any EP-05 item; all are directly operable in the UI.

epics.title: Prepayment
List approval workflow
epics.observations: US-07.2.2 is the only item graded. The warnings rail (domain/warnings with one rule, prepaymentUnpaid; store/warnings.ts with an office-only stored clearance; WarningsPanel with Clear) is the natural home for both new warnings, and reviewFlags.ts already notes that an insurer-will-pay rule belongs there. Correction to the first grader: the clearance mechanism exists. The gap is that the review row's triangle is display-only, so review needs a way to open or clear the warning in place. The story depends on US-11.4.3 (insurer and approval number on the Booking, today on the Procedure, which needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump), US-11.2.2 and US-11.2.4 (Booking payer and child-payer warning), US-03.1.9 (text as received, Contract, RVG code per Procedure) and US-03.6.3 (anaesthetist's flag for office check, new mobile flow). OQ-93 is still open on whether insurance narrows the Contract list and where the approval-number warning shows (office review, anaesthetist, or both), so build the review warnings as written and leave Contract-list narrowing alone. Demo guide: seeded Bookings on S1 to S5 lists that get authorised could newly show warnings, so tune the seed or script. docs/demo-guide was not checked line by line.

epics.title: Billing/Invoice Engine and internal ledger
epics.observations: Structural: the prototype has no internal ledger. The receivable/payable pair is created straight into the Xero simulation slice (state.xero.accRecs/accPays) by xeroHandoff.ts, so a ledger slice (control accounts, per-anaesthetist and per-patient sub-ledgers, AA Holding creditor) plus a ledger view is the largest missing piece and underpins FT-08.3, US-08.3.1, US-08.6.3 and US-08.6.5 (and the Xero mirror, FT-09.1). Prepayment still follows the old model: self-funded category, deposit or full estimate, pre-invoice pair paid to the anaesthetist as payments arrive, netted on the final invoice with a negative line. US-08.2.2 and the AA Holding payee need the prepaid-Contract and AA Holding work of EP-06 and EP-04 (US-06.3.1, US-06.5.1, US-06.4.1, US-04.2.14) first; multi-procedure ranking across all Procedures already works (feeContextFor index) so the left-off change itself is small. Additional invoices and credit notes depend on an Events model (FT-03.7), the review step (OQ-63) and EP-09 Xero mirroring; the interim addPostOpAddendum Booking is to be replaced (code comment: Phase 38b). US-08.4.5 depends on an anaesthetist GST number (profile, EP-12) and OQ-29. No item in this group is a Matches; EP-08 was regraded from Partial to Contradicts because its own text says prepaid Procedures are left off and the code nets them. Demo script impact: S3 'Money end-to-end' (billing run, Xero pair, payment, disburse) changes where the ledger pair and AA Holding show, and the final invoice for a prepaid Booking no longer shows the deduction line (an all-prepaid Booking has no invoice); any S1/S2/S4 beat using 'Add post-op event' changes to the additional-invoice button. PERSIST_VERSION bump needed for new ledger state and seed.

epics.title: Xero integration
epics.observations: EP-09 core (atomic pair creation, InvoiceNumber and Reference, ACCREC payment webhook and daily poll, per-case fault and retry) is built and largely matches. The structural gap is the AA Holding account: the prototype has none (no holding contact, no settlement pair), so US-09.1.3 contradicts, and the same wrong prepayment-payee behaviour is written into the FT-09.1 and US-09.1.1 body text, so both are graded Contradicts for it (one fix in US-09.1.3 closes all three). Build the holding-account entity and settlement pair with EP-06 (US-06.3.1, US-06.4.1, US-06.5.1) and have xeroHandoff take the payee from it. Minor point: the ACCPAY InvoiceNumber is the engine number plus '-P' while the text says each invoice carries the engine's number; decide whether this is deliberate. US-09.1.4 (buyer-created tax invoice wording, grouping) and US-09.2.4 (who pays: Xero payables run vs new system) hang on unresolved OQ-29 and OQ-111, so build only a labelled placeholder and a simulator-side 'ACCPAY paid in Xero' event. Demo script impact: S3 Beat 2 (Xero pair) and Beat 3 (Simulate payment and payout, Run payables) change if disbursement becomes Xero-detected; S4 Beat 1 (prepayment invoice) changes with the holding account and settlement pair; S3 Beat 4 (BCTI seeding) changes if BCTI grouping changes.

epics.title: Payments, disbursement and AA fees
epics.observations: Three in-scope items. FT-10.2 and US-10.2.1 match as written. The weekly cycle (US-10.2.7, Proposed) and the BCTI approval gate (US-10.2.6) are not built: Run payables is one unbadged button on the Billing monitor with no ISO-week period, Friday close, Monday check, Tuesday schedule, approved list or pre-run balance check. US-10.2.6 and US-10.2.7 should be built together, with US-09.2.4 / OQ-111 (who pays: Xero payables run or the new system). BCTIs exist only as a count (bcti.ts), so US-09.1.4 BCTI generation is related. The demo script S3 Beat 3 (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md) uses payment received then Run payables and would gain an approve step. The seed's disbursed history would need an approved flag or period, with a PERSIST_VERSION bump.

epics.title: Patients and billable parties
epics.observations: All 14 gradings upheld after re-opening the code. Structural: the prototype's EP-11 model is the old per-Procedure billingRoute (hospital / billableParty / insurer) with a separate Insurer master and a shared BillableParty (guardian) master, resolved in invoiceBuild.counterpartyForProcedure. The catalogue replaces all three: the Contract (holder's is-billed setting, EP-04 / US-04.1.5) decides who is billed, insurers are plain contract holders, and the payer (name, email, postal address) lives on the Booking prefilled from the patient (or a 'different payer' tick), with no guardian record. This is the XL refactor behind FT-11.2, US-11.2.1 and US-11.2.2, touching domain/types.ts, invoiceBuild.ts, validateBookingForBilling.ts, billingRun, Xero contact creation (a payer without a record), seed, tests and PERSIST_VERSION; it depends on EP-04 (is-billed flag, No contract (RVG) default, own-Contract) and FT-03.7 (event billable party). Mandatory NHI (US-11.1.1/11.1.4/11.1.5) removes the provisional patient (PT0010 Noah Prescott) and needs the unmatched queue and List stubs from EP-02 (US-02.1.4, FT-02.6, OQ-118); ManualBookingForm, ingestPdfRow, Review and web List 'NHI pending' badges all change. Balance alerts (FT-11.3 / US-11.3.2) and child-payer / missing-approval warnings (US-11.2.4, US-11.4.3) share the warnings framework already built in Phase 15a (WARNING_RULES currently only prepaymentUnpaid; warningSamples.ts already earmarks the child-payer and balance samples) plus a patient-level balance incl. credit from the billing mirror. US-11.1.2 is the one Matches; the only wrinkle is the catalogue's 'modulus 24' label for the current format versus the prototype's deliberate, on-screen-flagged mod 11 (true Health NZ algorithm); switching would break real NHIs, so treat the catalogue wording as a label error to raise with the owner. Open questions OQ-114, OQ-93, OQ-118, OQ-122 do not change grades but limit how far work can be finalised. Demo-guide beats affected: S2 Beat 2 (phone-advice booking, billingRoute hospital, NHI DEM1239), S3 Beats 1 and 2 (explicit payer per Procedure, nib / St George's, insurer-route invoice payer nib), S4 Beat 1 prepayment (Billable Party route), S5 Beat 3 (BP0001 hidden ID guardian, no personal info in Xero); S5 Beat 2 (NHI validator) stays valid; the Grace Park guardian and Noah Prescott 'NHI pending' seeds would be replaced by a child-as-payer warning demo and an unmatched-queue demo.

epics.title: Anaesthetist profile and reporting
epics.observations: Largest gaps: US-12.1.4 (no bank details anywhere; HPI CPN still optional so it needs mandatory validation in add and edit, bank fields on the sheets and record page, audit labels, bank values in the seed for all 13 anaesthetists (HPI CPNs are already seeded), and a PERSIST_VERSION bump from 25), US-12.2.1 (remove ageing everywhere and add a link from each line to its Booking), and US-12.2.2 (rebase the GST report on disbursements, monthly only, add download/email/print). Ageing removal is one change touching mobile AgeChip and the headline total, web Accounts Overdue table and tab name, the dashboard Receivables aging panel (US-12.2.3), and the selectors (bucketForAgingDays, receivablesAgingFor); do these in one phase. Replace the dashboard ageing panel with an owed / collected / paid out position (US-08.3.5). The gstPeriod profile field (Bi-monthly, Six-monthly; admin record, add/edit forms, Whitaker seeded six-monthly) is unnecessary under a monthly report and is also not among the profile settings FT-12.1 lists. Priority tier is another extra on the admin record (office-only, fine). Dependencies: US-10.1.2 (Disbursement records and case.disbursedAtISO already exist in the billing mirror; the GST of a payment comes from the linked invoice/receipt as Disbursement has no GST), US-08.3.1/08.3.2/08.3.5, US-05.2.7, US-13.6.3/13.6.4 (pairings already built, admin-only). Unit rate and pairings need no work; there is no anaesthetist-facing profile screen, which the catalogue does not require. OQ-123 (billing-practice reporting) is unanswered; nothing is demonstrably missing, only a future data hook. Demo-guide impact: S3 Beat 3 (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md around L464-480) says the row leaves 'Overdue', Beat 4 (~L504) discusses GST activity, and the navigation table (~L55-67) names these tabs; all change with the rename and rebase. Admin screenshots need seeded bank details.

epics.title: Admin oversight and master data
epics.observations: Single-item run for US-13.4.1, an umbrella master-data story with no acceptance criteria of its own, so graded against its list and closing paragraph. The closing work depends on other epics: the contract-holder master and removal of Insurers/accepts-direct-claims (US-04.1.5, status 3); 'No contract (RVG)' default and no Contract types (US-04.3.3 and the EP-04 pricing-model items); dated Contract versions (Contract maintenance stories, OQ-100); a master public-holiday calendar (the only catalogue mention is this story's list, US-01.5.1 covers only per-hospital calendars, so the master calendar is under-specified and may merit a question); RVG groups and modifier maintenance (EP-04 RVG/modifier stories, OQ-88, OQ-95). This story should re-grade as Matches once the Master data sub-nav replaces Insurers and Organisations with a Contract holders view and adds editable RVG groups, Modifier codes and a Public holidays view. Demo guide beats that flip an insurer to direct claims or rely on the default Type 1 contract, and any beat showing Master data nav order, would need updating. The story's mockup images show RVG and modifier codes as view only, so they reflect prototype state, not the intended maintained lists.

epics.title: Health systems integration
epics.observations:
EP-14 is Grouping. The real gaps sit in its children and in FT-02.1:
- The in-scope hospital download into a matching screen (FT-02.1, US-02.1.5, repeated in FT-14.6) does not exist. The code only has comments pointing to catch-up Phase 33. OQ-109 is still open: AA has not confirmed that St George's and Southern Cross are integrated today or synced in the first release, and the 27 Oct note has Ben naming Forte rather than one of the two. Any matching-screen work should wait for the answer.
- The HL7 v2 / FHIR simulator and the Admin Messages and Feed tabs are already badged Future scope (catch-up Phase 14, until Phase 34). They stay as illustration. Phase 34 is planned to demote them.
- The NHI lookup is in scope and is already simulated (domain/nzhis.ts lookupNhi, used in ManualBookingForm). Grade it under US-14.4.1 and FT-04 and FT-02 intake.
- The adapter and per-hospital transport matrix, the integration tier and progressive onboarding are only 'Technical discussion' proposals. They are not acceptance criteria.
- Demo guide beats affected by later work: S1 says the hospital download 'arrives in a later build', S2 beat 1 assigns the St George's Draft List, and S4 uses the dead-letter MSG-CPH-2001 beat. EP-14 itself breaks no scripted beat.

epics.title: Non-functional requirements
epics.observations: All four EP-15 items are cross-cutting and Proposed. Gaps map onto existing plan phases (all unbuilt): 43 (scale and privacy: in-memory full-scale dataset with timings, restricted raw-payload view, NHI leak scan, synthetic-data badge) for US-15.0.4 and US-15.0.6; 43a (sign-in, ease of use, point-of-need help, first-run hint) for US-15.0.1. US-15.0.2 Matches; web document download/email/print belongs to US-03.1.4 and US-12.2.2. Cross-item tension: US-15.0.1's Note ("anaesthetists see none of the Contract complexity") is Proposed and now yields to Confirmed US-03.1.2 and US-03.1.9, which require the Contract on anaesthetist screens; the prototype currently shows route chip plus Contract/insurer/payer context to anaesthetists, so 43a must keep the Contract but can drop the route chip. A scale loader must bypass persistence (5 MB budget), so no PERSIST_VERSION bump is needed. The raw-payload view ties to US-14.5.1 (dead-lettered HL7) and US-09.3.1 (already matches). Demo-guide impact: Xero beat and integration dead-letter beat gain a restricted-raw-view step; a scale beat would be new. A synthetic-data badge touches the shell harness bar and the PWA More tab.

items.summary: Epic's own model (rolling canvas, AM/PM Slot per anaesthetist, free by default, List placed in a Slot, Draft List with no anaesthetist, 'slot' never in UI) is built; real gaps sit in children US-01.5.2, 01.5.4, 01.6.3, 01.4.7.
items.requirement_says: Rolling schedule; every active anaesthetist has AM+PM Slot daily (free by default); active List sits in one Slot with one surgeon, anaesthetist, hospital; Draft List = no anaesthetist; the word 'slot' never shown; reference data by identity.
items.prototype_does: Slots stored for every active anaesthetist/day/session across the horizon; one List per Slot; DRAFT Lists with no anaesthetist/slot; UI says session/Draft List; hospital+surgeon required on every List.
evidence: searched: user-visible strings containing 'slot' in apps/shared/store/domain -> none (actionLabels.ts:78 says none)
items.verify_note: Re-read canvas.ts and grepped for user-facing 'slot' copy; none. Epic body states its own rules but the prototype satisfies them. The one epic-level tension is the seeded List on an Unavailable session (graded under US-01.5.2), not the model itself.
items.title: Schedule canvas, Slots and Lists

items.summary: Canvas generated at seed, rolled forward on clock day change, horizon editable in months (1 to 24) with extend/trim; status Proposed but behaviour matches the text.
items.requirement_says: Scheduling Engine pre-generates Schedule/Day/Anaesthetist/Slot structure across a rolling horizon (4 months default, any number of months).

items.requirement_says: Whoever submits a List did all its procedures; a Booking done by another anaesthetist is moved to that anaesthetist's List (even a single-Booking List). Unprepaid: payable follows the Booking to the doer. Prepaid: payable is the AA Holding account and does not move, the doer is paid from it at settlement; nothing is recalculated or re-triggered on the move.
items.prototype_does: submitList is owner-only and needs every non-cancelled Booking completed; anaesthetists cannot edit another's List. The office can move one Booking to any non-AUTHORISED List (MoveBookingFlow to reassignBooking), which touches no prepayment or invoice. The Xero handoff derives the ACCPAY payee from the Booking's List's anaesthetist at handoff time, so an unprepaid Booking moved before handoff is paid to the new anaesthetist. A prepayment invoice also hands off at once with a payable to the List's anaesthetist (raisePreProcedureInvoice then handoffCasesForBooking); there is no AA Holding creditor and no settlement transfer, and an already-created accPay keeps its anaesthetistId after a move (code comments mark a 'Phase 41 seam').

The prepayment itself is still the old deposit/self-funded model rather than the Contract-flagged full-amount prepayment of EP-06.
An already-handed-off unprepaid ACCPAY is not repointed when the Booking later moves (payee fixed at handoff).

An anaesthetist cannot move a Booking to a colleague as a new List: reassignBooking refuses anaesthetists unless both Lists are their own (notOwnList), the older reading. Only the office path produces 'Booking ends up on B's List' (see US-01.4.7).

items.summary: One editable operation text plus a Contract context line; received wording is overwritable, no rooms/hospital texts, no pricing basis, no invoice description, no 'still to choose' markers. Status Open.

items.title: Booking descriptions and Contract shown together

items.summary: Additional procedures never carry modifier units; catalogue rule splits modifiers across procedures when total exceeds 4. Base-on-primary is right.

Type 3 second-procedure pricing keyed by ordinal, not Contract multi-procedure rule

items.title: One primary Procedure

items.title: Anyone with edit rights can set the primary

items.summary: Anaesthetist and office can add further Procedures to a Booking, but the new Procedure silently inherits the first Procedure's Contract; the anaesthetist has no way to select its own Contract and the office select is unfiltered.
items.requirement_says: An anaesthetist or admin can add further Procedures to a Booking; each selects its own Contract (US-04.3.1).

items.title: Add additional Procedures

items.summary: An RVG code picker with search and base units exists, but the code is effectively required, ranged codes are clamped with an out-of-range validation FAILURE instead of a warning, and there is no Contract-line default, starting values from the Contract or reset on Contract change (status Verify: graded against the text as written).
items.requirement_says: Type-ahead RVG picker (code, short description, base units); the code is optional (not needed on a fixed price); a Contract line's default RVG code and starting base units/price/rate/discount fill in; base and modifier units may be set to any value including outside the published range, which is accepted and raises an after-procedure warning for the office; changing Contract resets the values.
items.prototype_does: CodePickerSheet is a bottom-sheet search (code or description), rows grouped by anatomical site showing code, name and base units. Range codes show a stepper clamped to min..max. validateBookingForBilling fails a missing code (unless a non-RVG line exists) and fails an out-of-range or unselected range value, and Mark complete is refused. UnitsCard steppers can set B/T/M to any number with no warning. Contract is set only by the office.

Only one warning rule exists (prepaymentUnpaid in domain/warnings/rules/index.ts); no out-of-range base-units warning (US-13.7.1)
No Contract-line default RVG code or line-stated base units (no Contract line concept yet, US-04.2.4)
No price, rate or discount starting values from the Contract; no reset on Contract change

Seeded RVG codes are 5-digit demo codes (e.g. 47516), so typing 'H1' finds nothing; picker is a sheet list, and its filter lowercases the query but not the code
Manual B override via UnitsCard has no warning when outside range
items.demo_trigger: Existing 'Raise sample warnings' (shared/demoTriggers/registry.ts:925) should carry a new out-of-range base-units sample once the rule exists.
items.verify_note: Re-read validator, picker, range stepper and warning registry. Confirmed the wrong behaviour (range failure blocks; code required). Contract-line defaults depend on EP-04 so may land later. Size M stands.
items.title: Choose the RVG code, with starting units

items.summary: Start now/Finish now stamps and time units work, but validation copy says 'handover' and times are mandatory on any RVG-coded Procedure even where the Contract fixes the price.
items.requirement_says: Record start and finish times (not handover); time units computed from them; time recording optional where the Contract fixes the price.
items.prototype_does: TimesCard 'Start now'/'Finish now' stamp the demo clock with nudges; stored as anaestheticStartISO/handoverISO; validator says 'Record the handover time.' and 'Handover must be after the anaesthetic start.'; times required whenever an RVG code is set, including fixed-price (Type 3) bookings that need an RVG code for price matching.

Field and audit labels still 'handover'

items.title: Record anaesthetic start and finish times

items.summary: Itemised modifier controls exist, but the ASA grade seeds modifier units, no explanation is asked for, the age modifier is not pre-applied, and a base-included modifier is struck through rather than shown selected at 0 (status Verify with OQ-95 open: graded against the text as written).
items.requirement_says: Only the age modifier and any modifier the code's base units already include are pre-applied and shown selected (included ones as a removable-no pill at 0 units); nothing else is pre-filled whatever the ASA grade. The anaesthetist itemises every other modifier from the RVG table plus AA's own, giving a short explanation for each claimed; saving requires the explanation.
items.prototype_does: AsaCard sets asaClass, and resolveBtm adds that AS code's units to the M total even when no chip is picked (caption 'ASA III seeds +3 modifier units'). ModifierChips shows exclusive-band segmented controls (PA, A, OB) plus stacking chips (PA5, ASE, P1, AI1, PO1, PO2) from a 20-row demo-plausible table. A code absorbed by the base (P1 on hip, shoulder, spine) is disabled and struck through with a refusal reason. No explanation field anywhere.
missing_or_wrong: ASA grade seeds modifier units (fee.ts resolveBtm lines 78-85, AsaCard caption), contradicting 'nothing else pre-filled, whatever the ASA grade'; the ASA should be just one optional modifier choice
No per-modifier explanation and no save requirement for one (searched modifierNote|modifierExplanation|explanation in src: none)
Age modifier not pre-applied (see US-03.3.8)
Included modifier shown disabled and struck through rather than as a selected pill at 0 units; absorbsModifierCodes covers P1 on a few demo codes, not the full neurosurgery/spine sets
Modifier table is 20 demo values (MODIFIER_CODES), not the RVG table plus AA's own (US-05.1.5)
Exclusive-band rule (one code per band) is the prototype's own unconfirmed assumption
The M stepper in UnitsCard can override the total, bypassing itemisation
items.verify_note: Read fee.ts, AsaCard, ModifierChips and modifierCodes; all points real. Corrected the count of codes (20, not 19). OQ-95 does not rescue ASA seeding because the story text and its 'nothing else pre-filled' AC are explicit.
items.title: Choose optional modifiers, each with a short explanation

items.summary: The age modifier is never applied from the patient's date of birth; A1/A2 exist only as manually picked (removable) chips in an exclusive band, with one seeded Booking carrying A1 by hand (status Verify, OQ-95 boundaries open).
items.requirement_says: The system applies A1 or A2 from the patient's DOB (procedure date basis, to confirm), shows it already selected, and the anaesthetist can remove it; a patient outside the RVG age bands gets no age modifier.
items.prototype_does: The patient's age is displayed on the Booking (ageYears) but unused for pricing. A1 'Age extreme, very old' and A2 'very young' are manual segments in the 'A' exclusive band. Margaret Ellison's seed Booking has selectedModifierCodes ['A1'] hand-set, so that one Booking opens with A1 selected and removable.
missing_or_wrong: No age-to-modifier rule in domain or store (searched 'A1'|'A2' in src: only seed/bookings.ts:431 and modifierCodes.ts:27-28)
No pre-selection when a Procedure is opened for any other patient; nothing computes 'outside the bands adds nothing'
Band boundaries (1, 2, 70, 80) and H6b/P2 handling undefined (OQ-95), so any rule needs a stated demo reading
items.verify_note: Searched age/DOB and A1/A2 use: confirmed no automatic rule. Downgraded Missing to Partial because the A1/A2 modifier codes exist and are removable, and one seeded patient (age 72) already opens with A1 selected, so the removable-selected behaviour is demonstrable, just not derived from DOB. Size S stands (pure function plus a hook on opening/creating a Procedure).
items.title: Age modifier from the patient's age

items.summary: Anaesthetist cannot choose a Contract; can only change billing route/insurer/category while ACTIVE; no reset; no review flag. Status Verify.
items.requirement_says: Anaesthetist changes the Contract (and line) until AUTHORISED from a filtered list, no reason; price/rate/discount reset; audited and flagged at review; common case insurer to No contract (RVG) bills patient or named payer.
items.prototype_does: EditProcedureSheet offers operation, billing route, insurer, payment category, reference; governing Contract select only in office EditBillingSetupSheet; anaesthetist locked out once SUBMITTED; edits audited as procedure.update; override/units not reset.
missing_or_wrong: No Contract picker for the anaesthetist (filtered per US-04.3.2)
Window ends at SUBMITTED not AUTHORISED
No reset of price/rate/discount/units on change
Not flagged for office review
No 'No contract (RVG)' Contract; switching route to billableParty is the nearest equivalent
items.verify_note: Re-read both sheets and editRefusal; confirmed.
items.title: Anaesthetist can change the Contract

items.summary: The anaesthetist always gets an override with a mandatory reason; the per-Contract flag, read-only price, fixed-price lock, prepaid lock and fixed-discount display are all absent.
items.requirement_says: What the anaesthetist can change depends on a per-Contract flag set by AA: price, rate or discount when allowed (100% discount or $0 gives a no-charge invoice); read-only price with no discount field when not; a fixed price always read-only; a Contract-fixed discount shown and not editable; prepaid never editable. No reason is needed; the change is audited and flagged at office review.
items.prototype_does: OverrideCard writes a typed priceOverride (dollarAdjustment or fixedFee) for any Procedure under capture, with a mandatory reason, rejecting totals below zero. % adjustment is office only. No Contract-level gating, no read-only mode keyed to Contract, no fixed discount shown.
missing_or_wrong: No Contract flag and no 'Not allowed' state (price read-only, no discount field)
No read-only 'Fixed price' on Type 3 or hospital fixed Contracts (anaesthetist can override them)
Prepaid Procedures not locked against override
No fixed-discount display where the price change would be
Reason required instead of 'saves without a reason'
No flag at office review for an anaesthetist-entered price or discount
Discount and rate not editable as such; no no-charge invoice path (fee at or below 0 refused in validator)
items.verify_note: Re-read OverrideCard and validator against all five ACs: Own pricing (partially, but ungated), Not allowed, Fixed price, Fixed discount and No reason all fail. Shares one implementation with FT-03.5.
items.title: Apply an anaesthetist adjustment

items.summary: BTM values are stored independent of the fee, but BTM/times are mandatory on any RVG-coded Procedure, including fixed price; zero fee raises no invoice.
items.requirement_says: Full BTM kept even at 100% discount (zero fee); BTM not mandatory on a fixed-price Contract, still mandatory on a fixed-rate Contract.

No-charge (zero) invoice not produced
items.verify_note: Forced times on fixed price is wrong behaviour against the stated rule, so Contradicts. The retention half matches. Agreed status so re-checked.
items.title: BTM still recorded in full

items.summary: Mark complete is validation-gated, but on the old rules: it needs a billing route and (RVG code or billing line), times on any RVG path, and route-specific details; it has no Contract requirement, no modifier explanation check and no 'prices from time' condition (status Verify with OQ-93 open: graded against the text as written).
items.requirement_says: Before marking complete, every Procedure needs a Contract, its times (where the Contract prices from time, not fixed price), and a short explanation for any claimed modifier. The RVG code is optional; holder references (insurance approval number) are the office's job; an incomplete Procedure can be sent to the office (US-03.6.3).
items.prototype_does: validateBookingForBilling (used by the Mark complete bar and store/lifecycle.ts) requires billingRoute, 'RVG base code or at least one billing line', start and handover times whenever an RVG code is set, an in-range selection for range codes, and insurer or payment-category / prepayment details per route. The bar shows failures and focuses the first incomplete control. It never checks governingContractId (except for rate x time lines), modifier explanation, or whether the Contract prices from time.
missing_or_wrong: Does not require a Contract (governingContractId unchecked; billingRoute checked instead)
RVG code effectively required (or a billing line), contradicting 'optional'
Times required whenever an RVG code is present, not conditional on the Contract pricing from time (fixed price needs none)
No modifier explanation check (no explanation field exists)
Out-of-range base units fail completion where it should only warn
Insurer / payment-category / prepayment detail demands are anaesthetist-blocking, where holder references are the office's job
No 'send to the office to resolve' path (US-03.6.3)
items.verify_note: Re-read the whole validator: governingContractId appears only in the Method 3 gate; no modifier-note or fixed-price conditionality. Confirmed the store lifecycle uses the same validator, so rework must be in the domain function.
items.title: Mark a Booking complete

items.summary: List submit blockers sheet names each incomplete Booking and exactly what is missing, on both apps.

N to finish' (mobile) and 'N to finish before submitting' (web) open SubmitListSheet blockers mode: each non-cancelled incomplete Booking by time and patient with every validation failure verbatim, or 'Ready to complete'; in-Booking latch focuses first missing field.

items.title: Ask the office to check a Booking or List

items.summary: The only mechanism is 'Add post-op event' on a locked Booking, implemented as a new Booking on a List, with none of the event fields (own date and time, time or fixed fee, invoice tick, billable party, admin entry), and it appears on a List, contradicting 'Not on a List' (status Agreed; OQ-12 and OQ-121 open).
items.requirement_says: From a current or past Procedure the anaesthetist (or an admin) adds an event with its own date and time, recording a time or a fixed fee, no modifiers; it is attached to the original Procedure, has an invoiced tick box and a billable party via a 'same as Procedure' tick. An event dated on another day does not appear on that day's List or schedule.
items.prototype_does: addPostOpAddendum (label 'Add post-op event', shown only when list.state === AUTHORISED) creates a new Booking on a new List in today's free session for the same patient, copying the first Procedure's billing setup. No form: no time or fee, date, tick box or billable party. The addendum shows on the day view and runs ordinary BTM capture, including modifiers.
missing_or_wrong: No event record with its own date and time; the date is today's session

No 'invoice' tick box and no unbilled event
No billable party with 'same as' tick
No pre-op events (ACC pre-op assessment; OQ-12)
Only on locked (AUTHORISED) Bookings, not 'current or past' Procedures; refused when no free session today
Event appears as a Booking on a List and schedule: contradicts the 'Not on a List' AC
No admin-entered path distinct from the generic office actor

items.verify_note: Re-read addPostOpAddendum and the button; every AC either unmet or contradicted. Shares the Event entity with FT-03.7 (the XL), so this story is L on top of it only for the form and the admin path.
items.title: Add a pre-op or post-op event to a Procedure

items.summary: Pieces exist in other shapes (a fixed-amount billing line with description before completion, and a separately invoiced addendum Booking afterwards), but no billing event with a free-text charge or credit after invoicing, no tick box, no review-state rule and no next-run behaviour (status Verify, OQ-121 open).
items.requirement_says: A billing event is a free-form charge (free-text description, amount) or a credit raised on a Procedure and its Contract, its own line item. Before the Procedure's invoice is approved it goes on that invoice; after the invoice has gone it is invoiced separately in the next run, traceable to the Procedure; same review step; an unticked event is not invoiced; a credit reduces what is owed.
items.prototype_does: BillingLinesCard / AddBillingLineSheet add a fixed ancillary amount (description plus amount) or rate x time (gated by the Contract's permitsIndividualArrangement) to a Procedure before completion; these join that Procedure's invoice. After authorisation an addendum Booking bills in its own full cycle with its own invoice. No credit notes or credit events.
missing_or_wrong: No Event entity: free-text charge exists only as a billing line before completion, not after invoicing
No credit event or credit-note effect (negative invoice never raised, invoiceBuild.ts:409-418; no credit notes in src)
No invoice tick box; no 'not yet through review, so not invoiced' state for an event
No rule that a different billable party gets its own invoice
'Next run' invoicing of a late event is modelled as a whole new Booking with its own capture cycle
Not shown in the Procedure's events (US-03.7.3); traceability only via addendumOfBookingId
items.demo_trigger: Admin billing screen button 'Run next billing run' to show an event recorded after the invoice appearing on a separate invoice traceable to the Procedure, and a 'Record credit event' action showing the owed amount fall.
items.verify_note: Checked BillingLinesCard path and the addendum path; Partial is fair since description+amount lines on the same invoice behave correctly pre-invoice and nothing is actively wrong. Overlaps phases 38b/39b (BillingLine entity to be removed), so size is bundled with FT-03.7's Event work.
items.title: Bill an event

items.summary: No Procedure shows a list of its events; the only linkage is a banner on the addendum Booking and the audit History sheet.
items.requirement_says: On a Procedure, both the Admin App and the Anaesthetist App list all its events (pre-op, post-op, additional invoices, credits; a refund can show as an event). A Procedure with a post-op event and an additional invoice shows both; a credit note against its invoice shows as an event.
items.prototype_does: Nothing. The Booking detail shows a 'Post-op addendum' banner on the addendum only; the original Booking shows no list of its addenda. The History sheet is an audit timeline, not an events list. No additional invoices or credit notes exist to show.
missing_or_wrong: No events section on a Procedure in mobile, web or admin
Original Booking does not list its addendum
No additional invoice or credit surfaced as events (depends on EP-08)
No refund-as-event record
items.verify_note: Searched for any list of events, addenda or linked invoices on a Booking/Procedure in shared, apps/admin and the mobile and web apps; found none. The addendum banner points backwards only.
items.title: See a Procedure's events

items.summary: The prototype is built on the July RFP model (Type 1/2/3 contracts, a required billingRoute plus optional governing Contract, protected hospital and insurer default Type 1s, Insurer master); the catalogue replaces it with one Contract per Procedure that decides pricing and who is billed.

Procedure carries billingRoute (hospital, billableParty, insurer) and an optional governingContractId; resolveContractForProcedure resolves the route first and falls back to a per-hospital or per-insurer default Type 1. Contracts are edited in place and deleted.

No 'anaesthetist may change pricing' or 'prepaid' Contract settings
Contracts are edited in place, can be backdated and can be deleted, with no dated versions
Insurer master and acceptsDirectClaims still drive routing
No stage-and-submit of Contract changes (US-04.1.6, outside this batch)
items.verify_note: Re-read types.ts, invoiceBuild.ts, contractActions.ts, the seed and EditBillingSetupSheet; every wrong-point is real. The epic states its own rules (single Contract, billed party, dated versions), so it is not Grouping.
items.title: Contracts

items.title: Contract catalogue

Two non-blocking, clearable warnings: a child (under 18) as payer, and an insurer named with no insurer Contract chosen; the List can still be authorised.
items.prototype_does: ReviewScreen shows one row per non-cancelled Booking: patient/NHI, primary operation (+n more), Route, the primary Procedure's governing Contract name, base RVG code, times, B/T/M, units, fee, and flags (not completed, no billing reference, ACC billed to patient, manual B/T/M override). The only registered warning rule is prepaymentUnpaid, shown as a read-only triangle beside the patient name. Authorise is never gated. Insurer, payer and Contract can be edited only on the admin Booking detail (OfficeBillingSetup / EditBillingSetupSheet), not from review rows, which have no row navigation (only History).
missing_or_wrong: No warning for 'Booking names an insurer but no Procedure has an insurer's Contract' (rule not registered in WARNING_RULES; reviewFlags.ts:66-68 comment says it is a later rule).
No warning when a patient under 18 is the payer on a Booking for a Procedure billed to the payer (US-11.2.4); ageYears exists in shared/format.ts but no warning rule uses it.

No insurer or insurance approval number shown on the review, and no field for the approval number anywhere (OQ-93 update 2026-10-28: its absence is a warning). The insurer is held per Procedure (domain/types.ts:838), not on the Booking, and is read only on the insurer route.
Review shows only the primary Procedure's Contract and RVG code, with '+n more'; no per-Procedure 'text as received, then Contract, then RVG code' (US-03.1.9).
No indication of whether a Procedure needs an insurer's Contract, nor the insurance status that came with the Booking.
The payer on the Booking is not shown in the review table, and cannot be changed from it (AC 2); payer editing exists only on the Booking detail.
No display of addresses or invoice email addresses on the review.
No 'flagged for the office to check' marker (US-03.6.3 has no prototype field).
No explicit 'approve Contract selections' action or per-Booking approved state, and no inline correct-Contract route from a review row.

The warning triangle on review rows is display-only: the 'Clear' action lives in WarningsPanel (Booking detail, WarningsToDo), so the AC 'warning the admin can clear' would not be satisfiable from the review screen itself without wiring a clear/panel there.
evidence: aa-prototype/src/shared/warnings/WarningTriangle.tsx (no Clear; Clear is in WarningsPanel, warnings.test.tsx:79-82)

The ACCPAY moves draft to authorised on first release; the BillingCase shows partPaid or paid. runPayables disburses only authorised minus disbursed, so there is no double payment. Web Accounts Payments table has Received by AA, Released to you, Paid to you columns. Part-payment demo trigger exists.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: 'Payment received · half' then 'Payment received · full' on the invoice page, then Billing monitor 'Run payables'.
items.verify_note: Story has no formal acceptance criteria, only the three behaviour sentences. Verified in code that part payment authorises exactly amountReceived (cumulative) and the remainder stays on the ACCREC (status awaitingPayment). The OQ-47 'engine authorises exactly the amount received' question is answered in the same direction as the code. The 'next payables run' wording is met by the single Run payables action. Not claimed: weekly cycle (US-10.2.7).
items.title: Payable released to match the amount received

Web Payments shows receipt against invoice number; Xero pair shows engine link.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Control panel 'Run reconciliation poll' and day advance catch the seeded missed-webhook payment.
items.verify_note: Confirmed Status: Confirmed item; re-read poll and receivePayment. 'Ledger as system of record' (US-08.3.2) is an EP-08 gap; here the BillingCase mirror stands in. Confidence stays medium for that reason.

summary_md:
### Headline

The prototype is the July RFP model with Phases 15 to 32 layered on. Calendar, Slots, Lists, Draft Lists, pairings, tiers, warnings engine, the AA fee run and the Xero simulation are close to the catalogue. Money and intake are not. Of roughly 235 graded items, about 40 Match, about 25 are Partial, about 15 are Missing, and the rest are Contradicts or Grouping. Contradicts dominates EP-02 to EP-08, EP-11 and EP-12: the prototype implements a different, superseded design there, not a smaller version of the new one. EP-01, EP-10 and most of EP-13 are near done. The core is one coordinated rework: Contract (holder, dated versions, lines, flags) replaces billing route plus Type 1/2/3. Pricing, completion, prepayment, invoicing, payer, review and events all hang off it. Statuses were not used to scope work; they appear below only where an open question (OQ) makes a gap unsafe.

### Themes

**1. Contract-centred billing (XL).** Billing route, optional governing Contract, Type 1/2/3 and protected default Type 1s go. In: holders with an is-billed flag, dated Contract versions with AA code, standalone lines, one AA-held No contract (RVG), mandatory Contract per Procedure, staged review and submit, authorisation snapshot, filtered picker, anaesthetist may change Contract until AUTHORISED. Items: EP-04, FT-04.1 to 04.3, US-04.1.1 to 04.1.6, US-04.2.x, US-04.3.x, FT-03.4, US-03.4.1, US-08.1.1, US-07.3.1. DM-07, DM-09, DM-10, DM-48, DM-49, DM-57, DM-08, DM-16. RV-06, RV-11, RV-18, RV-32. Split into model and maths, versioning and staging screens, picker and booking setup.

**2. Pricing, units and modifiers (XL).** Price, rate and discount become values on the Procedure; no mandatory reason; Contract flag gates the anaesthetist; $0 gives a no-charge invoice; discount is its own invoice line; modifier units split above four; RVG becomes a hidden-key master (NZSA 2021, duplicate codes); modifiers become records with explanations, age pre-applied, ASA ordinary; out-of-range warns instead of blocking; completion rules reworked ("finish", not "handover"). Items: FT-05.1 to 05.4, US-05.x, FT-03.3, FT-03.5, US-03.3.x, US-03.5.x, US-03.6.1. DM-13, DM-43, DM-44, DM-50, DM-14, DM-15, DM-46. RV-03, RV-04, RV-07 to RV-10, RV-21, RV-22, RV-38. Many S quick wins (NHI, wording, reason removal, make-primary).

**3. Hospital intake matching screen (XL).** Nothing exists: HL7/FHIR and PDF rows apply straight to Bookings. Needed: staged rows, match/create/Draft List/assign/reject, per-row change type, field differences for approval, unmatched queue, day move as cancel plus new, edits allowed until AUTHORISED, third feed (CPH) out of scope. Items: EP-02, FT-02.1, FT-02.5, US-02.1.1/2/4/5, US-02.5.7, US-02.3.1, EP-14 (boundary). DM-34, DM-51. RV-12 to RV-16.

**4. NHI mandatory and source text (M, tied to 3).** Remove provisional patients and "NHI pending"; waiting-for-NHI queue with urgency; text exactly as received per source plus a separate invoice description. Items: US-11.1.1, US-11.1.4, US-11.1.5, US-03.1.5, US-03.1.9, US-08.4.6. DM-30, DM-51. RV-20.

**5. Prepayment and holding account (XL).** Trigger is a prepaid Contract, amount is the line price, admin approval plus letter, payable to a holding account, second pair at authorise, refund on cancel, no automatic balance. Today the anaesthetist is paid before the procedure. Items: EP-06, FT-06.2 to 06.5, US-06.x, FT-08.1, FT-08.3, US-08.2.2, US-08.3.1, FT-09.1, US-09.1.1, US-09.1.3. DM-20, DM-21, DM-22. RV-05, RV-24.

**6. Events, additional invoices, credit notes (XL).** Post-op addendum Booking is replaced by events on the Procedure, additional free-form invoices, credit-in-full-then-rebill, negative payables netted in a weekly cycle. Items: FT-03.7, US-03.7.x, US-05.5.2, FT-08.6, US-08.6.1 to 08.6.5, US-10.2.6. DM-17, DM-18, DM-24, DM-25. RV-23.

**7. Edit window and anaesthetist views (M).** Anaesthetist edits stay open on SUBMITTED; a List leaves the main view at AUTHORISED (not billed); balances show invoices immediately; search by name/NHI/date; scroll back. Items: EP-07, FT-07.2, FT-07.4, US-07.2.1, US-07.2.3, US-07.4.1, US-07.4.2, US-03.1.6, US-03.1.7. DM-55. RV-19.

**8. OQ-81 reversal (M to L).** Unavailability is never a conflict; closed sessions not assignable by the office; sickness takes return-or-assign to a Draft List. Items: US-01.5.2, US-01.5.4, US-01.6.3, US-01.5.5, US-01.4.1. DM-56. RV-25.

**9. Single-Booking move and notification pool (M).** Anaesthetist moves one Booking by creating a List in a colleague's free Slot; pool notices gain resolve tick, count, show-resolved and an "ask the office" source. Items: US-01.4.7, US-01.4.6, US-01.4.2, FT-13.8, US-13.8.1 to 13.8.3, US-03.6.3. DM-42, DM-41. RV-26, RV-27.

**10. Payer, insurer, balances, warnings (L).** Payer name and email on the Booking; insurer and approval number on the Booking; patient balance alerts at 90 days; remaining warning rules; admin whole-ledger views. Items: EP-11, FT-11.2 to 11.4, US-11.2.2/3, US-11.3.2, US-11.4.x, US-13.7.1, US-07.2.2. DM-11, DM-12, DM-23, DM-31, DM-28. RV-30, RV-31, RV-36.

**11. Profile, reports, admin polish (M).** Drop GST period, add bank details, monthly GST report of payments passed on, flat owed list, preferred pairing orders candidates, audit excludes payments, cutover load, master calendar, simulated sign-in, scale and privacy demos, point-of-need help. Items: FT-12.1, FT-12.2, US-12.1.1, US-12.2.2, US-13.4.1, US-13.4.3, US-13.5.2, US-13.5.3, US-13.6.4, US-15.0.1, US-15.0.4, US-15.0.6. DM-29, DM-32, DM-35, DM-38, DM-45. RV-02, RV-33, RV-35.

### Structural first

Screen work built before these lands is rebuilt twice. Suggested order:

1. DM-13 (RVG group, hidden key), DM-48 (holders), then DM-07, DM-09, DM-49 (Contract versions, lines, No contract) in one step with DM-46 (remove BillingLine). Then DM-10 (Procedure picks Contract and line), which unblocks DM-43, DM-44, DM-50, DM-14, DM-15, DM-08 and DM-11.
2. DM-22 (internal ledger with its own payable) before DM-21 (holding account) and DM-20 (prepaid trigger); DM-17 (events) before DM-18, DM-24, then DM-25.
3. DM-30 (NHI required) and DM-51 (source text) before DM-34 (matching rows).
4. DM-57 (staged Contract changes) after DM-07 and DM-09.
5. Independent, can run any time: DM-55, DM-56, DM-42, DM-41, DM-32, DM-12. DM-29 follows DM-22. DM-45 is a policy note, fold into DM-07 or DM-24.

Every seed or type change needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump, canvas-golden and seed tests refreshed. About 26 non-test files read governingContractId or billingRoute, so DM-10 is the widest change.

### Remove or rework (reverse check)

- Remove: attachments on Bookings and Lists (RV-01, M); GST period (RV-02, S); rate x time billing and Method 3 flag (RV-03, M; keep fixed ancillary lines until events exist); ACC "should not bill patient" review flag (RV-37, S).
- Rework (large): prepayment category and split (RV-05), default Type 1 fallback (RV-06), billing-time re-resolution (RV-11), route plus Type model (RV-18), prepaid pair paying anaesthetist (RV-24), addendum Booking (RV-23), HL7 auto-apply and third feed (RV-16).

### Demo impact

- S2: Beats 1b, 3 and 3a (sickness conflict, assign to closed session) change with OQ-81. Phone-advice beat needs the optional "as given" text and mandatory NHI. Beat 3c (own move) gains single-Booking move. Beat 4 and "submit sheet" copy change with the until-AUTHORISED edit rule; review screen content changes. Notification beat loses busy-morning paging.
- S3: billing Beats 1 to 2 (payer/route wording, pair), split-billing and two-funder beats, payables beat if the prepay payable moves to the holding account, GST and balances messaging (invoices now immediate).

- Unchanged: FT-02.4 ad hoc add (bar NHI), S2 own-move line "nothing recalculated", most fee-run beats.

dataModelDeltas.title: The RVG group becomes the one master list (hidden key, type-ahead rows, modifier units, printed base-unit range, AA groups); there is no procedure list
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Base units sit on the RVG group: the NZSA RVG as published plus AA's own groups, each with code, description, anatomy heading, base units (always set, above 0), modifier units (default 0), a hidden unique key (codes repeat across rows) and, since OQ-101 (29 Oct), the printed base-unit range where the guide gives one, shown to the anaesthetist who picks the exact figure. The RVG groups are the one master list: no procedure list, no body-section picker, no general procedure (OQ-88; US-05.1.6 Retired). Type-ahead shows code, short description, base units. The RVG code on a Procedure is optional. Seeded once, then maintained by hand with every change audited.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Only RvgCode keyed by its code string: code, description, anatomicalSite, baseUnits single or range (the range is already held), absorbsModifierCodes; 34 demo rows, shown in a view-only Master Data table with no create, edit or retire action (ReferenceViews.tsx:234). Procedure.rvgBaseCode is a scalar string into it and the validator requires one unless a billing line exists. No hidden key, no duplicate-code rows, no modifier units, no AA-added groups, no type-ahead showing base units, no write path for the master.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Foundation of the pricing track. RvgCode gets a hidden id, anatomy heading and modifier units; Procedure.rvgBaseCode becomes an optional group reference (22 non-test files read it); absorbsModifierCodes moves to DM-44's included-modifier link. Seed needs the real NZSA list; the code picker gains type-ahead rows; Master Data gains audited add, edit and retire actions for the group (and see DM-38). Must precede DM-09, DM-43, DM-44.

dataModelDeltas.title: The contract holder becomes a master record (insurer, hospital, surgeon, anaesthetist; AA holds No contract) with an is-billed flag, a billable party, an invoice delivery output and a practitioner link; the Insurer master goes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every Contract belongs to a holder: insurer, hospital, surgeon or anaesthetist (own price list); AA holds No contract (RVG). Insurers are holders like any other: the insurer master list and accepts-direct-claims flag were retired 28 Oct (FT-11.4, US-11.4.1, US-11.4.2). A surgeon's arrangement is held against individual surgeons, not rooms (OQ-105), and is one Contract linked to every surgeon it covers (Donald, 29 Oct). Each holder records whether AA invoices it (billable party required) or only sets the price (Booking payer billed), how its invoices are delivered (email or another output; flag on the holder or its billable party, OQ-114 open), and optionally the practitioners it belongs to by practitioner ID (one anaesthetist, or one or more surgeons), so Contracts are offered only on their Bookings. The office creates anaesthetists' and surgeons' holders and Contracts from supplied price lists (OQ-91).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: No holder entity. Contract carries holderType hospital|insurer|surgeon|organisation|billableParty plus holderId into four disjoint tables (hospitals, insurers, surgeons, organisations; billable parties); ContractScope individualAnaesthetist is the only practitioner link (one anaesthetist); a surgeon holder is a single surgeonId. An Insurer master with acceptsDirectClaims (types.ts:338, :345) exists, is seeded, edited in Master Data and gates the Insurer route (44 non-test files mention insurers, 10 read the flag). No is-billed flag, no delivery output. A SurgeonGroup master (types.ts:288) and an 'organisations' master (:352) also exist.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New holder master with CRUD; Contract.holderType/holderId (10 files) become a holder reference and the practitioner link becomes a list of surgeons beside one anaesthetist. The Insurer master and acceptsDirectClaims are removed (insurer becomes a holder kind: seed, Master Data view, Insurer route in invoiceBuild and validator, booking-setup sheets). 'organisation' and 'billableParty' holder kinds have no counterpart (a group becomes a surgeon holder linked to its surgeons). dataModelDeltas.title: The Contract becomes a series of dated versions with an AA code and behaviour flags; Type 1/2/3, scope, the default per holder and the Method 3 gate go
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Contract is a series of dated versions (start, optional end, review date, forward link); every change creates a new version from a date the office chooses (never past, nothing deleted), only one future-dated version at a time; the version in force on the procedure date prices the Procedure; on submit un-invoiced Procedures relink to the new version's line by line key (a prepaid one keeps its price, OQ-104 confirmed 27 Oct). Every Contract has a unique AA code (OQ-66). Behaviour flags set by AA: editable (anaesthetist may change price, rate, discount), prepaid, default (No contract (RVG)), plus invoice layout and GST. New 28 Oct: a prepaid Contract is never editable and its line price must be above zero (OQ-96); a fixed price never allows the anaesthetist's override (OQ-117); delivery is no longer a Contract setting.

dataModelDeltas.title: The Contract line (standalone, carrying only what it sets, with a system line key) replaces ContractPrice
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Contract has lines or none. A line stands alone (no nesting, no procedure link; several may share a default RVG code; a combination is a line of its own) and carries only what it sets: a never-reused system line key kept across versions, an optional holder reference code unique within the Contract and searchable, a description that starts the invoice description, an optional default RVG code, and any of fixed price (ex GST), rate, discount, base or modifier units. Blank is not set, 0 is a value. Removed: procedure link, RVG mapping, time band, add-on flag, quantity rule, price tier, line dates. New 28 Oct: on a prepaid Contract a line with no price or a zero price is refused.

dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every Procedure references exactly one Contract (and one line where it has lines) before its Booking can be marked complete. dataModelDeltas.title: Starting units come from the Contract line, then the RVG group, and become the Procedure's own values; any value is accepted and an out-of-range one only warns
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Choosing the Contract (and line) and RVG code fills the Procedure's starting values: base units from the RVG code or the line where it states its own; modifier units from 0 plus any system-applied modifier; price, rate, discount from the line. They are then the Procedure's own values, changeable to any figure including outside the published range, which raises an after-procedure warning and never blocks. Where the group holds a printed range the anaesthetist is shown it and chooses the exact base units (OQ-101). Changing the Contract resets them. RVG code optional.

No Contract-line layer, no reset on Contract change. The validator fails a missing or out-of-range selection (validateBookingForBilling.ts:152 to :165) instead of warning.

dataModelDeltas.title: Pricing is one rule on values held on the Procedure: its price, else (base + time + modifier) x rate x (1 - discount); Type 2/3 pricing goes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Procedure is priced by its Contract and the values held on it (Donald, 18 Oct). If it holds a price (line fixed price, prepaid amount, or one entered by someone permitted) that is the price and BTM is reference only. Otherwise (B+T+M) x rate x (1 - discount): rate is the line's, else the anaesthetist's own unit value; discount shown as its own invoice line. Price 0 gives a no-charge invoice; BTM required on a fixed-rate Contract. Prices use the Contract version in force on the procedure date; submission is rejected when no price can be worked out; all prices ex GST.

Price, rate, discount not held on the Procedure; no price source recorded.

dataModelDeltas.title: Price changes become edits of the Procedure's own price, rate and discount: the anaesthetist where the Contract is editable and the price is not fixed or prepaid, the office on any Contract, no reason, last change stands
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The Contract's editable flag (set by AA) says whether the anaesthetist may change price, rate or discount. Two limits override it: a fixed price never allows the anaesthetist's override (OQ-117, 29 Oct) and a prepaid Contract is never editable (OQ-96, 28 Oct; a difference is a second invoice or credit by hand). Where not allowed the price is read-only and they change the Contract or ask the office. The office can change any price on any Contract, fixed or prepaid included. No reason needed (US-03.5.3 Retired); every change audited and flagged at review; last change stands; changing the Contract resets values.

dataModelDeltas.title: Multi-procedure rule: one primary flag, time on every procedure, modifier units split above four, no Contract-specific ordinals
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every Booking has exactly one primary Procedure, set by anyone with edit rights. Base units only on the primary. Time units on every Procedure from its own start and finish (1 per 15 min for two hours, then 1 per 10; part interval rounded up; tiers held as data). Modifier units all on the primary while the Booking total is 4 or fewer, otherwise split as evenly as possible with the remainder to the primary. No Contract changes the rule (US-04.2.5, US-05.3.4 Retired; OQ-90). The ranking counts all Procedures, prepaid or not (US-08.2.2).

dataModelDeltas.title: Authorising a List snapshots each Procedure's Contract version, line and pricing values; the billing engine reads the snapshot
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: On AUTHORISED the engine snapshots, per Procedure, the Contract version (each version its own record), values on the Procedure (units, price, rate, discount), recorded BTM, rate and discount used, the price and payer or billable party details. Later changes to RVG groups or Contracts never alter an issued invoice, which can always be reproduced. Before authorisation, a revised Contract refreshes values from the revised line (a prepaid Procedure keeps its invoiced price); how that relinking meets the lock is not stated (US-04.2.10 note).

dataModelDeltas.title: The Contract carries invoice layout, GST treatment and the holder references a Booking must supply; the delivery method moves to the contract holder
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Contract sets invoice layout (holder or patient; the holder's carries the BTM breakdown) and GST treatment (US-04.2.8). Delivery (email or another output such as a portal) is no longer a Contract setting: it is a flag on the holder or its billable party (28 Oct; OQ-114; see DM-48). The Contract also names the references its holder needs on invoices (insurer member number, holder reference such as SXAP); the office supplies them on the Booking. One free-text Procedure.billingReference with its completeness check (validateBookingForBilling.ts:49). No delivery-method field anywhere; emailing is a stamp (billingRun.ts:411).

dataModelDeltas.title: Each Procedure keeps the text exactly as received from each source, the rooms' and the hospital's apart, plus a separate invoice description
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each Procedure keeps the procedure text exactly as each originating system sent it (rooms' and hospital's apart), never edited or overwritten; a later update with different wording is added beside it with source system and time; manual entry keeps what was typed. There is no procedure master. Booking screens show it above the Contract and RVG code. A separate invoice description, starting as the chosen line's description else the Booking's and editable without touching the received texts, is what the invoice prints. Open: which description an RVG Contract prints (OQ-103), where each feed carries the text (OQ-13).

dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Single description field confirmed; US-02.5.7 is not in the Future Work lane.

dataModelDeltas.title: Who is billed: the Contract's holder or the payer named on the Booking (any party, with an email or postal address), replacing the per-Procedure billable-party override and the billing routes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each Procedure's Contract decides who is billed: the holder's billable party when the holder pays AA, otherwise the payer on the Booking. Every Booking names a payer prefilled from the patient (name, email, postal address) and editable by the office or the anaesthetist to any party who pays: parent, guardian, benefactor, family trust. A billed payer needs an email or a postal address (NZ Post standard). Payer details are held on the Booking (a 'different payer' tick), kept for the life of the debt then archived, no guardian master record; under-18 payer is a mild warning. Billable parties are reference records (hospitals, surgeons, insurers, patients). One invoice per distinct billable party per Booking. Where the contact rule is enforced is not stated; posted invoices are OQ-122.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Per-Procedure billablePartyId override pointing to a BillableParty master (a guardian with relationshipToPatient, phone, email, free-text address; types.ts:195) created by createBillableParty (billablePartyActions.ts:21) with its own Xero contact. Default payer is the patient on the Billable Party route. Counterparty is a CounterpartyRef union (types.ts:148) chosen by counterpartyForProcedure (invoiceBuild.ts:192). No Booking-level payer, no different-payer tick, no payer-contact rule.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Booking gains payer fields (name, email, NZ Post-form postal address, different-payer flag) prefilled from the patient; counterparty resolution becomes holder billable party or Booking payer; the guardian master is replaced by the Booking payer (kept until the debt is settled); the contact rule needs a home (review or completion); Xero contact keying stays on a hidden id. 13 non-test files read billablePartyId. Needs DM-48 and DM-10; DM-28, DM-20, DM-31 build on it.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: counterpartyForProcedure read in full and matches; reader count (13) re-grepped.

dataModelDeltas.title: Splitting a Procedure's fee between payers is a Booking action with typed $ or % shares, not a line-level funder override
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: On a Booking the user presses a button against a Procedure to split the invoiced fee between several billable parties; each share is a typed $ or %, each party invoiced its share on its own invoice. It is a user action, not a Contract or Procedure setting (US-04.2.12 Retired), separate from an additional invoice. Basis is our pick (OQ-68); whether % shares must total 100 is open (US-08.2.3, US-08.2.1; OQ-23).

Grouping invoices by distinct counterparty per Booking is built (invoiceBuild.ts:264) and aligned.

dataModelDeltas.title: The Booking carries the insurer and the insurance approval number, editable by the office and by the anaesthetist; a missing approval number is a warning, and insurance guides the Contract but never decides who is billed
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An insured Booking holds the insurer (says whether the patient has insurance at all) and the approval number as Booking fields, shown on the matching screen and editable by the office and by the anaesthetist, who may learn of approval on the day (28 Oct; the earlier 'office's job, not the anaesthetist's' is dropped). No insurer master list: the insurer references a contract holder. A missing approval number is a warning, never a block; the anaesthetist can complete without it; if not approved the patient is billed. Insurer-will-pay with no insurer Contract is a review warning. No Insurer billing route. Open (OQ-93, US-11.4.3 back at Verify): where the warning shows, whether the anaesthetist sees the number or only 'approved', and whether insurance narrows the Contract list.
